THE SCARS, SHOWN

THE LADDER

CONSERVATIVE · 3 POTS · NEVER EMOTIONAL

The conservative ladder — Plan A, adopted Nov 22: the roll splits into 3 pots of $185.62 — one pot in play, two held untouched in reserve. Stakes re-base off the active pot as it grows, and a win resets to rung 1. A full bust — five straight losses — costs $113.28 and stops everything: known before the first bet is ever placed.

SAVED ALTERNATIVE — PLAN B · AGGRESSIVE (2 POTS)

Kept on the shelf for a future switch — not the live strategy. The roll splits into 2 pots of $278.43; stakes $9.28 · $14.28 · $36.25 · $92.02 · $120.00, sized to fully recover at the 1.65 floor through rung 4. One bust costs $271.83, and pot 2 unlocks only after pot 1 busts and a deliberate re-decision — two busts end the programme.

Risk is shown, not hidden: drawdown, worst sequence and the conservative ladder sit together so the cost of a cold run — and the exact recovery path — is always one tap away.

GATE RECEIPTS — WHY A BET FIRES

FIVE CHECKS · ALL MUST PASS · ANY FAILURE = SKIP, POSTED WITH ITS REASON
  • CHECKClock in window — an early look opens at 60′: Over T+1.0 above 2.00 fires early. The main entry lands inside 63–75′ — later is chasing.
  • CHECKOne bet, next goal only — exactly ONE bet per signal, on the NEXT second-half goal. Nothing else is chased.
  • CHECKRanked by one-goal outcome — lines run lowest first — Over T+0.5, then T+0.75, then T+1.0, all relative to the live score — and are ranked by what one more goal does to them: a line where one goal fully cashes (Over 2.5 at 2–0) is preferred over one where it half-cashes (Over 2.75). Push lines — Over 3.0 and above at 2–0, where one goal only pushes the stake back — are never taken.
  • CHECKOdds floor — the live line must price at or above 1.65. Below the floor, the edge is gone and so are we.
  • CHECKLadder stake verified — the stake is read off the conservative ladder — Plan A, three pots — by deterministic code. The neural core never touches the money math.

Every card in the BETS tab carries the receipt from its own placement — the same five checks, stamped at the moment the bet fired. A skip is a receipt too: the failed check is the reason posted.

HOW THE MACHINE WORKS

01 · SIGNAL

Alpha GOAL scans

Imran's signal engine watches world football and fires only on its highest-conviction second-half goal setups.

➜
02 · PERCEIVE

The neural core reads the phone

An on-device neural core reads the live betting app through its accessibility tree — no cloud, no OCR guesswork — and reports exactly what's on screen as structured data.

➜
03 · EXECUTE

The baby dragon strikes

ONE bet only, on the NEXT second-half goal. From 60’ an early look runs: Over T+1.0 above 2.00 fires on the spot. Otherwise the main window, 63–75’, goes lowest line first — Over T+0.5, then T+0.75, then T+1.0, relative to the live score (at 1–1 that’s Over 2.5, 2.5/3 and 3) — each at or above the 1.65 floor, and push lines, where one goal only returns the stake, are never taken. The phone places the bet at the ladder’s current rung, human-paced, gate-checked, abort-on-ambiguity.

➜
04 · REMEMBER

The ledger forgets nothing

Every signal, decision, placement and settlement is written to a permanent ledger. Wins reset the ladder. Losses climb it. The record on this page is that ledger, shown plain.
